retrievalProfile.description: A sepia-toned urban composition featuring two oversized figures standing as giants over a city bridge and skyline.

recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle urban scene where two men in oversized jackets are composited to appear as giants, towering over a suspension bridge and city buildings, rendered in a high-contrast sepia and olive duotone palette with bold, blocky typography in the upper left.
coreVisualRelationships: Scale contrast between giant human subjects and miniature city architecture
Diagonal tension created by the bridge perspective and the stance of the figures
Color harmony between the sepia-toned image and the purple/green typographic accents
Layered depth with the bridge in the foreground, figures in the midground, and city in the background
coreInvariants: Sepia or olive-toned monochromatic photographic treatment
Forced perspective making human subjects appear larger than infrastructure
Low-angle camera perspective looking up at the subjects

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two male figures dominate the center and right, scaled to approximately 80% of the vertical frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The figure on the right with a wide stance acts as the primary anchor, grounding the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bold text in the top left, follows the diagonal line of the bridge upward to the faces of the giants, and then down their legs to the city below.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the frame is densely packed with architectural detail and large-scale figures.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep purple for primary display text
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright lime green for text shadows and highlights
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast in the shadows and highlights of the clothing.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to duotone or tritone photographic processing

characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are bisected by a diagonal color shift
Enclosed within a thin-stroke rectangular border

composition.relationshipToImage: floating over the shoulder of the left figure

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with varying color treatments and offsets.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a sepia-toned urban scene featuring a suspension bridge in the foreground and a city skyline. Composite two men in oversized 90s streetwear so they appear as giants standing behind the bridge, towering over the buildings.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, condensed uppercase sans-serif text in the top left corner. Use a purple fill with a lime green offset shadow. Enclose the top word in a thin purple box.

verificationChecks: Check that figures appear significantly larger than the bridge
Ensure the color palette is restricted to sepia/olive tones with purple/green accents
Verify the text is stacked and condensed in the top left

adjustableVariables: Scale of the giant figures relative to the bridge
mustRedesign: Exact bridge architecture to avoid specific landmarks
postGenerationChecks: Are the giants correctly integrated into the urban environment?
Is the sepia tone consistent across the entire image?
Does the typography feel heavy and grounded in the 90s style?
Is the diagonal perspective of the bridge maintained?
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Giantism = (Low-angle Cityscape + Forced Scale Human Subjects) * Sepia Duotone Filter + (Bold Condensed Stacked Type / Offset Color Shadow)
